panelDiscussion.title: Panel: Big Model Adaptation for Computer Vision
panelDiscussion.description: This panel brings together the invited speakers to discuss current challenges and future opportunities in adapting large pretrained models for computer vision. Topics will include post-pretraining strategies, prompting techniques, and the role of vision models in multimodal systems.
panelists: Hilde Kuehne - University of Tuebingen / MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab
